webhooksPage.title: Webhooks
webhooksPage.description: Send match events (ready to connect, live, map and score, finished, cancelled, reset) to another website as signed HTTP requests, e.g. an event website that shows players a "connect now" banner. Every delivery is signed with the endpoint's secret and retried with backoff until it gets a 2xx.
webhooksPage.allowPrivate: Allow webhooks to private and local addresses
webhooksPage.allowPrivateHelp: For LAN events whose website runs on the LAN (10.x, 192.168.x, 127.0.0.1, ...). Link-local addresses (169.254.x.x) are always blocked.
webhooksPage.sourceHelp: Only if another site creates your teams through the API. Enter the name of that site's API token, and every event also carries that site's own ID for each team, so it can tell which team is which. Leave it empty if you're not sure.
webhooksPage.deleteBody: {{url}} stops receiving events, and its delivery log is removed.
webhooksPage.secretOnce: Paste this into the webhook settings of the site that receives these events. It uses it to check that each request really comes from this site. You only see it now: if you lose it, make a new one with Rotate secret (the old one keeps working for 24 hours, so you have time to update the other site). A Discord webhook doesn't need it.
webhooksPage.redactedNote: Connect details (server address, password, steam:// link) are redacted here; the receiver gets them in the signed delivery.
webhooksPage.formatSignedHelp: The signed event JSON, for your own service. Check the signature with the secret.
webhooksPage.formatDiscordHelp: Paste a Discord channel webhook URL (Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks). Each event posts a message; no passwords or connect lines go to Discord, only a link to the match page.
webhooksPage.short: Send events to Discord or your own services.
webhooksPage.allowPrivateShort: For services on your own network (LAN, Docker).
